title: LectureToMCQEvaluationItemMetadata
description: Standardized metadata schema for individual items in the Lecture-to-MCQ evaluation dataset.

dataset_id.description: Unique standardized item identifier (e.g., VM-TM1-001 or VO-BATCHA-002)

subject.description: Domain or subject category (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, English Grammar)

topic.description: Specific instructional topic or lesson title

audio_file.description: Relative filename of primary audio recording, or null if material-only

supporting_material_files.description: Array of relative filenames for slides, PDF, DOCX, TXT, or code files

duration.description: Audio length formatted as MM:SS or HH:MM:SS, N/A for material-only, or UNKNOWN/TBD

language.description: Spoken/written language of instruction (e.g., English, Hinglish, Telugu-English)

teaching_style.description: Observed instructional style (e.g., Expository, Socratic, Board Walkthrough, Slide Voiceover, UNKNOWN/TBD)

content_type.description: Nature of recording (e.g., Academic Instruction, Worked Problem, Classroom Management, Pure Motivation, Casual Banter)

expected_content_behavior.description: Target behavioral partition for assessment evidence vs context

expected_representation_route.description: Expected Architecture E route if provided by human reference; UNKNOWN/TBD during ingestion

expected_usable_concepts.description: Human/reference list of assessable target concepts. Empty or UNKNOWN/TBD if unannotated. Never auto-invented.

expected_excluded_content.description: List of segments or topics that must be excluded from MCQ stems (e.g., motivation, attendance, exam dates)

special_conditions.description: Audio quality, background noise, multi-speaker, dialect notes, or boundary conditions

contributor.description: Teammate identifier, batch code, or source origin
